intro: Vanuatu's islands are volcanic, with active volcanoes you can stand beside.

chapters.title: Volcanoes
text: Mount Yasur on Tanna is one of the world's most accessible active volcanoes. Ambrym has lava lakes. Espiritu Santo is the largest island.

chapters.title: Hazards
text: Vanuatu is often ranked one of the countries most at risk from natural disasters.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Vanuatu's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
